_comment: Starting point for .playbook-jupi/config.local.json — SETUP fills and writes this, the user never copies or edits it by hand. No key here may ever hold a secret: the store is reached through the Jupi connector, authenticated by the connector itself. Keys starting with '_' are documentation; nothing reads them.
_interview: The five values below are the only ones a human answers. Setup asks them as questions about their work and resolves each itself — never as a path to type.
_jupiWorkspace: the Jupi team space this process belongs to (probe: search-decisions-tool with this slug answers; 'Group not found' means wrong slug)
_playbook: WHICH playbook this folder runs — the instance name every pb-* call carries, so one workspace can run several. Set from the prelude's new-or-existing question; the address, not the label (renaming the playbook upserts the playbook-name entry and leaves this alone)
_playbookSources: the owner documents the playbook is extracted from — an array of paths/refs. Several is normal: the main process doc plus the templates it refers to
_dossierSource: where the tracked items are listed (a sheet, a CSV, a database) — one row per dossier
_watchedSource: the inbound source the watch sweeps — an address means a mailbox. Read from the connected mail account and confirmed, never typed. Absent = the watch degrades; extraction and planning still run
_derived: Written by setup after extraction, because it names a stage that does not exist at interview time.
_inboundStage: the declared-lifecycle stage meaning 'something came in and is waiting to be handled'. Must be one of the declared stages; absent = inbound attaches without a stage move and the gap is flagged
_defaults: Set by setup and mentioned in one line — never asked.
_projectionTarget: where the human-readable playbook projection is rendered, whole, from the rows
_guardrails: mode 'draft' = nothing leaves the user's tools without a settled decision (conservative until trust builds); 'perform' enables real verbs. decisionBudget caps decisions raised per planner run
_crawlWindowDays: how far back the watch sweeps when no cursor exists yet
_leaseMinutes: the run lease: any run (catchup, daily, go, process-reply) yields to a live run younger than this; older = stalled, taken over
_suspendThreshold: counter-evidence (edited outcomes) before a validated entry is automatically suspended back to case-by-case; a severe incident suspends at 1 regardless
